drhp.business: Precot has been in the textile industry since 1962 and runs a vertically integrated business with two segments: yarn and threads, and technical textiles. Its units are located in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka, with seven plants and a spinning capacity of about 1.65 lakh spindles (about 70 tonnes of yarn per day), fully compact-yarn enabled. The yarn and thread business supplies textile mills, garment manufacturers and brands on a B2B basis. The technical textiles business, based on spunlace technology at Hassan in Karnataka, makes absorbent cotton and cotton pads for feminine hygiene and cosmetics uses and supplies them as private-label products to international retailers, distributors and brands. The company sells in over 18 countries, and its cotton is sourced mostly in India, with the rest from the USA and Australia.

themes.title: Textiles - apparel/home-textile exports + synthetics
themes.need: India textiles ride three tailwinds at once: China+1 sourcing shifts, the India-UK FTA (signed) + India-EU FTA (advancing), and US tariff normalization - favouring apparel exporters (GOKEX/PGIL/PDSL) and US-heavy home-textile names (WELSPUNLIV/HIMATSEIDE). A second leg = value-added synthetics/recycling (FILATEX, SANATHAN, CENTENKA, GANECOS) and cotton-yarn spread recovery (VTL/NITINSPIN/SPORTKING) plus branded apparel (PAGEIND, ARVIND, RAYMONDLSL).
themes.driver: FTA implementation + US-India trade-deal clarity; festive/wedding demand; cotton-yarn spread; anti-dumping rulings.
